title: Hunts FH-031V: Let an author place a stop at the finale Event
detail: FH-031T credits an Event stop through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence (checkInAtFinaleAction, loadFinaleStop finds the one mission bound to a live hunt_placements row of medium event). Nothing writes a placement of medium event yet: bindStopPlacements in lib/hunts/store.ts binds qr placements only, so the check-in tap never shows. Owed: the Trail editor lets an author mark one stop as the finale stop when a finale Event is picked, and publish binds that stop to a placement of medium event. Note: hunt_claim_apply trusts the service-role caller for event_door evidence (it does not re-read attended_at); whether to verify the door mark in SQL is a decision to take with the FH-044S hunt_claim_apply redefinition, not a second redefinition. Hunts switches stay OFF.
